binomial_tree_ref'
definitions.body:
binomial_tree_ref' ?tree \<equiv>
unless (?tree = NULL)
 (do {
    guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard ?tree);
    guard
     (\<lambda>s.
         uint (refcount_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?tree)) < INT_MAX);
    modify
     (t_hrs_'_update
       (\<lambda>a.
           hrs_mem_update
            (heap_update ?tree
              (refcount_C_update (\<lambda>a. a + 1)
                (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?tree)))
            a))
  })

definitions.name: binomial_tree_unref'
binomial_tree_merge'
definitions.body:
binomial_tree_merge' ?heap ?tree1.0 ?tree2.0 \<equiv>
do {
  guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard ?tree1.0);
  guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard ?tree2.0);
  data1 \<leftarrow>
    gets (\<lambda>xb. value_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xb)) ?tree1.0));
  data2 \<leftarrow>
    gets (\<lambda>xc. value_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xc)) ?tree2.0));
  ret'int'1 \<leftarrow> binomial_heap_cmp' ?heap data1 data2;
  (tree1, tree2) \<leftarrow>
    return
     (if 0 <s ret'int'1 then (?tree2.0, ?tree1.0)
      else (?tree1.0, ?tree2.0));
  ret'ptr_to_void'1 \<leftarrow>
    malloc' (word_of_nat (size_of TYPE(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C)));
  new_tree \<leftarrow>
    return
     (PTR_COERCE(unit \<rightarrow> StrictC'_BinomialTree_C)
       ret'ptr_to_void'1);
  condition (\<lambda>s. new_tree = NULL)
    (return NULL)
    (do {
       guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard new_tree);
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_tree
                 (refcount_C_update (\<lambda>a. 0)
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree)))
               a));
       guard
        (\<lambda>s.
            uint (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) tree1)) < INT_MAX);
       guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard tree1);
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_tree
                 (order_C_update
                   (\<lambda>b. order_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) tree1) + 1)
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree)))
               a));
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_tree
                 (value_C_update
                   (\<lambda>b. value_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) tree1))
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree)))
               a));
       size \<leftarrow>
         gets
          (\<lambda>xm.
              word_of_nat (size_of TYPE(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr)) *
              UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 64)
               (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xm)) new_tree)));
       ret'ptr_to_void'1 \<leftarrow> malloc' size;
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_tree
                 (subtrees_C_update
                   (\<lambda>a.
                       PTR_COERCE
                        (unit \<rightarrow> StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr)
                        ret'ptr_to_void'1)
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree)))
               a));
       condition (\<lambda>s.
                     subtrees_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree) =
                     NULL)
         (do {
            ret \<leftarrow>
              free'
               (PTR_COERCE(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C \<rightarrow> unit)
                 new_tree);
            return NULL
          })
         (do {
            dest \<leftarrow>
              gets
               (\<lambda>xq.
                   PTR_COERCE
                    (StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr \<rightarrow> unit)
                    (subtrees_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xq)) new_tree)));
            src \<leftarrow>
              gets
               (\<lambda>xr.
                   PTR_COERCE
                    (StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr \<rightarrow> unit)
                    (subtrees_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xr)) tree1)));
            count \<leftarrow>
              gets
               (\<lambda>xs.
                   word_of_nat (size_of TYPE(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr)) *
                   UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 64)
                    (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xs)) tree1)));
            ret \<leftarrow> memcpy' dest src count;
            guard
             (\<lambda>s.
                 c_guard
                  (subtrees_C
                    (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree) +\<^sub>p
                   sint
                    (UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 32 signed)
                      (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree)) -
                     1)));
            guard
             (\<lambda>s.
                 - INT_MAX - 1
                 < uint (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree)));
            guard
             (\<lambda>s.
                 uint (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree))
                 \<le> INT_MAX + 1);
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update
                      (subtrees_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree) +\<^sub>p
                       sint
                        (UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 32 signed)
                          (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_tree)) -
                         1))
                      tree2)
                    a));
            i \<leftarrow>
              whileLoop (\<lambda>i s.
                            i <s UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 32 signed)
                                  (order_C
                                    (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree)))
                (\<lambda>i.
                    do {
                      guard
                       (\<lambda>s.
                           c_guard
                            (subtrees_C
                              (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
                                new_tree) +\<^sub>p
                             sint i));
                      tree \<leftarrow>
                        gets
                         (\<lambda>xx.
                             h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xx))
                              (subtrees_C
                                (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xx))
                                  new_tree) +\<^sub>p
                               sint i));
                      ret \<leftarrow> binomial_tree_ref' tree;
                      guard (\<lambda>s. 0 \<le> 2147483649 + sint i);
                      guard (\<lambda>s. sint i < INT_MAX);
                      return (i + 1)
                    })
               0;
            return new_tree
          })
     })
}

definitions.name: binomial_heap_merge_undo'

definitions.body:
binomial_heap_insert' ?heap ?value \<equiv>
globals.with_fresh_stack_ptr 1 (\<lambda>a. UNIV)
 (\<lambda>fake_heap\<^sub>p.
     globals.with_fresh_stack_ptr 1 (\<lambda>s. UNIV)
      (\<lambda>new_tree\<^sub>p.
          do {
            ret'ptr_to_void'1 \<leftarrow>
              malloc' (word_of_nat (size_of TYPE(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C)));
            guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard new_tree\<^sub>p);
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (hrs_mem_update
                 (heap_update new_tree\<^sub>p
                   (PTR_COERCE(unit \<rightarrow> StrictC'_BinomialTree_C)
                     ret'ptr_to_void'1))));
            condition (\<lambda>s.
                          h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree\<^sub>p =
                          NULL)
              (return 0)
              (do {
                 guard
                  (\<lambda>s.
                      c_guard
                       (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree\<^sub>p));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update
                           (PTR(unit ptr)
                             &(h_val (hrs_mem a)
                                new_tree\<^sub>p\<rightarrow>[''value_C'']))
                           ?value)
                         a));
                 guard
                  (\<lambda>s.
                      c_guard
                       (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree\<^sub>p));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update
                           (PTR(16 word)
                             &(h_val (hrs_mem a)
                                new_tree\<^sub>p\<rightarrow>[''order_C'']))
                           0)
                         a));
                 guard
                  (\<lambda>s.
                      c_guard
                       (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree\<^sub>p));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update
                           (PTR(16 word)
                             &(h_val (hrs_mem a)
                                new_tree\<^sub>p\<rightarrow>[''refcount_C'']))
                           1)
                         a));
                 guard
                  (\<lambda>s.
                      c_guard
                       (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) new_tree\<^sub>p));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update
                           (PTR(StrictC'_BinomialTree_C ptr ptr)
                             &(h_val (hrs_mem a)
                                new_tree\<^sub>p\<rightarrow>[''subtrees_C'']))
                           NULL)
                         a));
                 guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard fake_heap\<^sub>p);
                 guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard ?heap);
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                           (heap_type_C_update
                             (\<lambda>b.
                                 heap_type_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap))
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                         a));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                           (compare_func_C_update
                             (\<lambda>b.
                                 compare_func_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap))
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                         a));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                           (num_values_C_update (\<lambda>a. 1)
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                         a));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                           (roots_C_update (\<lambda>a. new_tree\<^sub>p)
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                         a));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                           (roots_length_C_update (\<lambda>a. 1)
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                         a));
                 result \<leftarrow>
                   binomial_heap_merge' ?heap fake_heap\<^sub>p;
                 unless (result = 0)
                  (modify
                    (t_hrs_'_update
                      (\<lambda>a.
                          hrs_mem_update
                           (heap_update ?heap
                             (num_values_C_update (\<lambda>a. a + 1)
                               (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap)))
                           a)));
                 tree \<leftarrow>
                   gets
                    (\<lambda>xu.
                        h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xu)) new_tree\<^sub>p);
                 ret \<leftarrow> binomial_tree_unref' tree;
                 return result
               })
          }))

definitions.name: binomial_heap_pop'
definitions.body:
binomial_heap_pop' ?heap \<equiv>
globals.with_fresh_stack_ptr 1 (\<lambda>a. UNIV)
 (\<lambda>fake_heap\<^sub>p.
     do {
       guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard ?heap);
       condition (\<lambda>s.
                     num_values_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) = 0)
         (return binomial_heap_null_value)
         (do {
            (i, least_index) \<leftarrow>
              whileLoop (\<lambda>(i, least_index) s.
                            i < roots_length_C
                                 (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap))
                (\<lambda>(i, least_index).
                    do {
                      guard
                       (\<lambda>s.
                           c_guard
                            (roots_C
                              (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                             uint i));
                      least_index \<leftarrow>
                        condition (\<lambda>s.
h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
 (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p uint i) =
NULL)
                          (return least_index)
                          (do {
                             ret \<leftarrow>
                               condition (\<lambda>s.
       least_index = 0xFFFFFFFF)
                                 (return 1)
                                 (do {
                                    guard
                                     (\<lambda>s.
   c_guard
    (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
      (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p uint i)));
                                    x \<leftarrow>
guard
 (\<lambda>s.
     c_guard
      (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
        (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
         uint least_index)));
                                    guard
                                     (\<lambda>s.
   c_guard
    (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
     uint least_index));
                                    data1 \<leftarrow>
gets
 (\<lambda>xe.
     value_C
      (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xe))
        (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xe))
          (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xe)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
           uint i))));
                                    data2 \<leftarrow>
gets
 (\<lambda>xf.
     value_C
      (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xf))
        (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xf))
          (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xf)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
           uint least_index))));
                                    ret'int'2 \<leftarrow>
binomial_heap_cmp' ?heap data1 data2;
                                    return (if ret'int'2 <s 0 then 1 else 0)
                                  });
                             return
                              (if ret \<noteq> 0 then i else least_index)
                           });
                      return (i + 1, least_index)
                    })
               (0, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            guard
             (\<lambda>s.
                 c_guard
                  (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                   uint least_index));
            least_tree \<leftarrow>
              gets
               (\<lambda>xd.
                   h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xd))
                    (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xd)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                     uint least_index));
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update
                      (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                       uint least_index)
                      NULL)
                    a));
            guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard fake_heap\<^sub>p);
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                      (heap_type_C_update
                        (\<lambda>b. heap_type_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap))
                        (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                    a));
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                      (compare_func_C_update
                        (\<lambda>b.
                            compare_func_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap))
                        (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                    a));
            guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard least_tree);
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                      (roots_C_update
                        (\<lambda>b.
                            subtrees_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) least_tree))
                        (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                    a));
            modify
             (t_hrs_'_update
               (\<lambda>a.
                   hrs_mem_update
                    (heap_update fake_heap\<^sub>p
                      (roots_length_C_update
                        (\<lambda>b.
                            UCAST(16 \<rightarrow> 32)
                             (order_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) least_tree)))
                        (h_val (hrs_mem a) fake_heap\<^sub>p)))
                    a));
            ret'int'1 \<leftarrow>
              binomial_heap_merge' ?heap fake_heap\<^sub>p;
            condition (\<lambda>s. ret'int'1 \<noteq> 0)
              (do {
                 result \<leftarrow>
                   gets
                    (\<lambda>xm.
                        value_C (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' xm)) least_tree));
                 ret \<leftarrow> binomial_tree_unref' least_tree;
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update ?heap
                           (num_values_C_update (\<lambda>a. a - 1)
                             (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap)))
                         a));
                 return result
               })
              (do {
                 guard
                  (\<lambda>s.
                      c_guard
                       (roots_C
                         (h_val (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                        uint least_index));
                 modify
                  (t_hrs_'_update
                    (\<lambda>a.
                        hrs_mem_update
                         (heap_update
                           (roots_C (h_val (hrs_mem a) ?heap) +\<^sub>p
                            uint least_index)
                           least_tree)
                         a));
                 return binomial_heap_null_value
               })
          })
     })

definitions.name: binomial_heap_free'
binomial_heap_new'
definitions.body:
binomial_heap_new' ?heap_type ?compare_func \<equiv>
do {
  ret'ptr_to_void'1 \<leftarrow>
    calloc' 1 (word_of_nat (size_of TYPE(StrictC'_BinomialHeap_C)));
  new_heap \<leftarrow>
    return
     (PTR_COERCE(unit \<rightarrow> StrictC'_BinomialHeap_C)
       ret'ptr_to_void'1);
  condition (\<lambda>s. new_heap = NULL)
    (return NULL)
    (do {
       guard (\<lambda>s. c_guard new_heap);
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_heap
                 (heap_type_C_update (\<lambda>a. ?heap_type)
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_heap)))
               a));
       modify
        (t_hrs_'_update
          (\<lambda>a.
              hrs_mem_update
               (heap_update new_heap
                 (compare_func_C_update (\<lambda>a. ?compare_func)
                   (h_val (hrs_mem a) new_heap)))
               a));
       return new_heap
     })
}

definitions.name: malloc'
definitions.body:
malloc' ?size \<equiv>
do {
  guard (\<lambda>s. binomial_heap_input.malloc.size_' < unat ?size);
  guard (\<lambda>s. allocator_wf (phantom_machine_state_' s));
  assume_result_and_state
   (\<lambda>s.
       {(p, t).
        \<exists>h A.
           malloc_rel (unat ?size) (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
            (phantom_machine_state_' s) (ptr_val p) h A \<and>
           t =
           t_hrs_'_update (hrs_mem_update (\<lambda>_. h)) s
           \<lparr>phantom_machine_state_' := A\<rparr>})
}

definitions.name: calloc'
free'
definitions.body:
free' ?ptr \<equiv>
do {
  guard (\<lambda>s. allocator_wf (phantom_machine_state_' s));
  guard
   (\<lambda>s.
       ?ptr = NULL \<or>
       (\<exists>y.
           live_blocks (phantom_machine_state_' s) (ptr_val ?ptr) =
           Some y));
  assume_result_and_state
   (\<lambda>s.
       {(r, t).
        \<exists>h A.
           free_rel (ptr_val ?ptr) (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s))
            (phantom_machine_state_' s) h A \<and>
           t =
           t_hrs_'_update (hrs_mem_update (\<lambda>_. h)) s
           \<lparr>phantom_machine_state_' := A\<rparr>})
}

definitions.name: memcpy'
definitions.body:
memcpy' ?dest ?src ?count \<equiv>
do {
  guard (\<lambda>s. allocator_wf (phantom_machine_state_' s));
  guard
   (\<lambda>s.
       memcpy_ok (phantom_machine_state_' s) (ptr_val ?dest) (ptr_val ?src)
        (unat ?count));
  assume_result_and_state
   (\<lambda>s.
       {?dest} \<times>
       {t. \<exists>h.
              memcpy_rel (phantom_machine_state_' s) (ptr_val ?dest)
               (ptr_val ?src) (unat ?count) (hrs_mem (t_hrs_' s)) h \<and>
              t = t_hrs_'_update (hrs_mem_update (\<lambda>_. h)) s})
}

definitions.name: int_compare'
